body:
Move the remaining work from `plan/` into GitHub issues, one issue at a time, with Joe's agreement on each. Agreed in chat on 2026-10-19.

## Do

- Make an issue for each phase not yet done, and each open item still open. Titles and bodies don't use phase numbers, except for the phase 13 issues (#47, #48). Refer to other work by its issue number.
- In the plan doc, strike out each moved phase or item, and add "Moved to #N."
- Close open item 8 with no design doc change: "**Closed 2026-10-19:** not needed. Accepted on a development server." Do it in one of this work's PRs, not a PR of its own.
- Add an issue template with the sections the phase issues use: Design, Open questions, Do, Done when, Ends in, and Settled in.
- Delete `plan/batch-4.md`.
- Freeze `plan/`: add a line at the top of each file saying it's frozen and work is tracked in the project. Update CLAUDE.md and DEVELOPMENT.md so new work goes in issues, and `plan/` is read only to look up an old phase or open item.

## Done when

- Every phase not yet done, and every open item still open, has an issue or a closed line.
- CLAUDE.md and DEVELOPMENT.md no longer send new work to `plan/`.

## Ends in

PRs that change only `plan/`, CLAUDE.md, DEVELOPMENT.md, and the issue template.

**Settled in:** chat.
